description: Create a config that defines routing, cache, retry, and targets for requests; use update_config to modify an existing one and list_config_versions for history. At least one setting is required, new configs become active immediately once referenced by a key or prompt, and the call returns the new id and version_id.

retry_on_status_codes.description: HTTP status codes to retry on (e.g., [429, 500, 502, 503])

targets.description: Array of target providers with virtual keys

provider.description: Provider slug to route requests to

virtual_key.description: Virtual key slug to use for this routing target

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to create config in

name: create_config

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
